data.body: Deterministic reproduction (session a85e3cd3): in an unlocked latest-resolution venv (pytest 9.2.0, FastAPI 0.162.0, Starlette 1.10.0), 'pytest -p no:xdist tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor' gives 1 failed, 1 passed every run; the same venv with only pytest set to 9.0.3 gives 2 passed. The two victim modules alone in one process reproduce all 6 failures (6 failed, 136 passed). A State.__delattr__ tracer shows the deletion comes from MonkeyPatch.undo() -> delattr(app.state, 'config') at the teardown of test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile (the polluting test). Cause: pytest 9.2.0 (pytest-dev/pytest#14962) records setattr's old value from target.__dict__, which Starlette's State never populates. A full local -n 3 worksteal run with the locked pytest 9.0.3 did not reproduce, consistent with this.
